query:
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.tokens,
  u.createdAt,
  u.lastLoginAt,
  -- Last visitor event for this user
  (SELECT ve.page FROM visitor_events ve WHERE ve.appUserId = u.id ORDER BY ve.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastPage,
  (SELECT ve.eventType FROM visitor_events ve WHERE ve.appUserId = u.id ORDER BY ve.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastEventType,
  (SELECT ve.createdAt FROM visitor_events ve WHERE ve.appUserId = u.id ORDER BY ve.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastEventAt,
  -- Last user action
  (SELECT ua.actionType FROM user_actions ua WHERE ua.userId = u.id ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastActionType,
  (SELECT ua.createdAt FROM user_actions ua WHERE ua.userId = u.id ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastActionAt
FROM app_users u
WHERE u.tokens = 10
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 30;
